question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who kills somebody, especially for political reasons
solution:
The correct answer is "**Assassin**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options **the word "assassin" **(हत्यारा) **can substitute the given phrase. **
 
• **An assassin is a person who kills somebody, especially for political reasons**.(वह व्यक्ति जो किसी की हत्या करता है, विशेषकर राजनीतिक कारणों से)
 
 
• Example: He was shot dead by an assassin.
 
• The act of assassination is considered illegal and is a serious crime.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monster (राक्षस):** A monster is a mythical creature that is typically large, ugly, and frightening.
 
• **Criminal (अपराधी):** A criminal is a person who has committed a crime and is therefore subject to punishment.
 
• **Hangman (जल्लाद):** A hangman is a person who carries out executions by hanging.
